searchText: I added a comment to the PR of the draft EIP7949 (tx type for separation of sender/payer), would like to get some feedback on if there's big glaring issues with my idea https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7949 fyi we usually try to avoid technical discussion on eip PRs as it can be harder to outside readers to follow along later. i think it's better to post on eth mag or here aint no eth mag post for this one yet 😭 Re: your comment- an opcode would definitely be useful, but it still doesn't really address the fact that a standard tx doesn't have the ability to both perform a user operation _and_ send gas payment to a sponsor. This EIP would need some "execute code in EOA context" function, like 5806 should probably be banging on the authors' doors then 😉 i did hit up ansgar on telegram lol <@415548822983278593> why u ghosting Since both 5806 and 7949 are transaction types, they're mutually exclusive during a transaction. It might make sense to merge them into a single transaction that does both delegation and gas sponsorship.
